heading: Residents Raise Museum and Media Center Concerns at Budget Workshop
summary: The Committee of the Whole took up the mayor's recommended 2027 budget. Staff presented a proposed levy of about $39.2 million. A resident urged alders to protect museum and Media Center staffing and suggested redirecting money from other positions.

heading: Public Works Backs Reserved Senior Parking Proposal
summary: The committee considered reserved parking for older residents in public parking lots. Members discussed how the designated spaces would work before voting. The motion carried.
